arguments.title: Last-Minute Hostess Gift: Printable Cocktail Party Kit
arguments.description: A last-minute gift for the friend who always hosts: 3 printable holiday bar menus, 12 bartender-tested recipes, shopping lists and a batch calculator, delivered instantly. Pair it with a bottle from the menu.
arguments.alt_text: Last-Minute Hostess Gift: Printable Cocktail Party Kit

arguments.title: Holiday Party Prep Timeline (Bartender's Countdown)
arguments.description: A 3-day holiday party countdown: shop and print menus 3 days out, make syrups 2 days out, batch the base the day before, then citrus, ice and garnish the day of. Buy 1–2 lb of ice per guest. Full timeline in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Holiday Party Prep Timeline (Bartender's Countdown)

arguments.title: 3 Holiday Mocktails for Your Party Menu
arguments.description: Zero-proof holiday drinks that don't feel like an afterthought: Cranberry Rosemary Fizz, Spiced Apple Cider and Sparkling Pomegranate. Serve them in the same glass with the same garnish. Recipes and printable menus in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: 3 Holiday Mocktails for Your Party Menu

arguments.title: How Many Bartenders Per Guest? Event Staffing Ratio
arguments.description: Event bar staffing: one bartender per 50 guests for a full bar, and estimate 2 drinks per guest the first hour and 1 per hour after. The Mobile Bartending Profit + Booking OS staffs and prices events automatically.
arguments.alt_text: How Many Bartenders Per Guest? Event Staffing Ratio

arguments.title: Self-Serve Holiday Bar Setup: Party Hosting Tips
arguments.description: How to host without being stuck behind the bar: batch 2 of your 3 drinks, make 1 built in the glass, set up a self-serve garnish tray and put the printed menu where the line forms. Menus and recipes in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Self-Serve Holiday Bar Setup: Party Hosting Tips

arguments.title: Mobile Bartending Booking Rules: Deposits and Balances
arguments.description: Protect your mobile bar business: take a non-refundable retainer, collect the balance before the event and send written cancellation terms with every quote. Track inquiries, deposits and follow-ups in the Mobile Bartending Profit + Booking OS.
arguments.alt_text: Mobile Bartending Booking Rules: Deposits and Balances

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu: 3 Drinks + Zero-Proof
arguments.description: An easy NYE bar menu: French 75, Negroni Sbagliato, Classic Champagne Cocktail and a zero-proof Sparkling Pomegranate. One case of sparkling wine covers all four. Printable and editable menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu: 3 Drinks + Zero-Proof

arguments.title: 3 Bottles, 7 Holiday Cocktails: A Small Holiday Bar
arguments.description: Build a holiday bar from three bottles: bourbon for an Old Fashioned, Whiskey Sour and Hot Toddy; gin for a Gimlet and Gin Sour; sparkling wine for a French 75 and Champagne Cocktail. Printable menus and batch math in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: 3 Bottles, 7 Holiday Cocktails: A Small Holiday Bar

arguments.title: Ugly Sweater Party Drink Menu (With Real Recipes)
arguments.description: Name your ugly sweater party drinks after the sweaters: Tacky Tinsel Mule, Itchy Wool Old Fashioned, Light-Up Spritz and a zero-proof Pom-Pom Fizz. Editable printable menus and the recipes are in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Ugly Sweater Party Drink Menu (With Real Recipes)

arguments.title: Easy Holiday Cocktail Garnishes (Sugared Cranberries + More)
arguments.description: Five cheap holiday cocktail garnishes: rosemary sprigs, fresh cranberries, dried orange wheels, cinnamon sticks and star anise. Sugared cranberries: dip in simple syrup, roll in sugar and let them dry about an hour. Recipes in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Easy Holiday Cocktail Garnishes (Sugared Cranberries + More)

arguments.title: How Many Glasses for a Party? The 2-Per-Guest Rule
arguments.description: Plan 2 glasses per guest for a holiday party, because glasses get set down and forgotten. Rocks glasses for stirred drinks, stemless wine glasses for spritzes and punch, flutes for bubbles, mugs for warm drinks. Shopping lists in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: How Many Glasses for a Party? The 2-Per-Guest Rule

arguments.title: Adult Hot Cocoa Bar: Holiday Party Setup
arguments.description: Set up a grown-up hot cocoa bar: cocoa held warm in a slow cooker, a spike station with bourbon, peppermint schnapps, Irish cream, dark rum and orange liqueur (1 to 1½ oz per mug), and toppings in bowls. Every mug starts zero-proof.
arguments.alt_text: Adult Hot Cocoa Bar: Holiday Party Setup

arguments.title: Christmas Cookie and Cocktail Pairings for a Cookie Swap
arguments.description: Pair holiday cookies with cocktails: gingerbread with a Hot Toddy, shortbread with a Holiday Old Fashioned, chocolate crinkles with a Chai Spice Espresso Martini, sugar cookies with a Hugo Spritz and snickerdoodles with zero-proof spiced cider. Recipes in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Christmas Cookie and Cocktail Pairings for a Cookie Swap

arguments.title: How to Choose a Signature Drink for Your Holiday Party
arguments.description: Pick a signature party drink like a bartender: easy to batch, seasonal, named after an inside joke and first on the menu. One pitcher covers most of the party. 12 recipes and editable menus in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: How to Choose a Signature Drink for Your Holiday Party

arguments.title: Secret Santa Gift Ideas for a Home Bartender
arguments.description: Secret Santa ideas for the friend with a bar cart: a jigger, a bottle of aromatic bitters, good cocktail picks and printable holiday bar menus. Wrap it with ribbon. The menus are the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit, an instant download.
arguments.alt_text: Secret Santa Gift Ideas for a Home Bartender

arguments.title: Bottled Batch Manhattans: A DIY Host Gift
arguments.description: Bring a batch instead of wine: 16 oz bourbon or rye, 8 oz sweet vermouth, 16 dashes aromatic bitters and 5 oz cold water in a 1 L swing-top bottle, chilled overnight. Serves 8. Batch amounts for 12 holiday drinks in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Bottled Batch Manhattans: A DIY Host Gift

arguments.title: Christmas Eve Drink Menu: Cozy Winter Warmers
arguments.description: A cozy Christmas Eve drink menu: Chai Spice Espresso Martini, Hot Toddy, Mulled Wine and a zero-proof Spiced Apple Cider. Mulled wine and cider hold warm in slow cookers all night. Printable menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Christmas Eve Drink Menu: Cozy Winter Warmers

arguments.title: Holiday Party Night-Before Checklist
arguments.description: The night before your holiday party: batch the cocktail base and label it, make syrups, print the menus, count 2 glasses per guest and clear freezer space. Squeeze citrus the day of and buy double the ice. Full prep timeline in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Holiday Party Night-Before Checklist

arguments.title: Home Bar Setup: Keep It Clean During a Party
arguments.description: Bartender habits for a clean home bar during a party: trash and recycling at the bar, one damp and one dry towel, a dump bucket, backup ice in a cooler and one wipe after every drink. Menus and prep plan in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Home Bar Setup: Keep It Clean During a Party

arguments.title: Instant Download Gift for the Host: Printable Bar Menus
arguments.description: A last-minute gift that needs no shipping: 3 printable holiday bar menus, 12 bartender-tested recipes, 10-serving amounts and shopping lists for 20 guests. Print the menus and wrap them with a bottle from the list.
arguments.alt_text: Instant Download Gift for the Host: Printable Bar Menus

arguments.title: Christmas Dinner Drinks Plan: Welcome to Dessert
arguments.description: Plan Christmas dinner drinks like a menu: a spritz to welcome guests, wine with dinner at 1 bottle per 2 to 3 guests, an espresso martini or mulled wine for dessert and a zero-proof on the table all night. Recipes in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Christmas Dinner Drinks Plan: Welcome to Dessert

arguments.title: Personalized Gift Idea: A Home Bar Menu With Their Name
arguments.description: A personalized last-minute gift: an editable holiday bar menu with their name at the top, printed on heavy paper and paired with a bottle from the menu. From the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit, an instant download.
arguments.alt_text: Personalized Gift Idea: A Home Bar Menu With Their Name

arguments.title: Christmas Eve Party Prep: What to Do the Night Before
arguments.description: The night before Christmas Eve: batch the cocktail base, make honey syrup (equal parts honey and hot water), chill the bubbles, print the menu and set up the bar. The day of, it's just citrus, ice and garnish. Menus in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Christmas Eve Party Prep: What to Do the Night Before

arguments.title: 10-Minute Christmas Eve Gift: Printable Bar Menus + a Bottle
arguments.description: A Christmas Eve gift in 10 minutes: download the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit, print the menus, pick up a bottle from the menu and tie it with ribbon. 3 printable menus and 12 recipes.
arguments.alt_text: 10-Minute Christmas Eve Gift: Printable Bar Menus + a Bottle

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu and 6-Day Plan
arguments.description: A ready-made New Year's Eve cocktail menu: French 75, Negroni Sbagliato, Classic Champagne Cocktail and a zero-proof Sparkling Pomegranate. Shop on the 28th, batch on the 30th, pour on the 31st. Printable menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu and 6-Day Plan

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Party Countdown: 5-Day Prep Plan
arguments.description: A 5-day New Year's Eve countdown: set the headcount and menu, shop on Dec 28, make syrups and batch on Dec 30, then citrus, ice and garnish on Dec 31. Plan 6 flutes per bottle of sparkling wine. NYE menu and timeline in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Party Countdown: 5-Day Prep Plan

arguments.title: How Much Champagne for New Year's Eve? Bottles Per Guest
arguments.description: New Year's Eve champagne math: a 750 ml bottle pours six 4 oz flutes. For a toast only, buy 1 bottle per 6 guests; for bubbles all night, about 1 bottle per guest; one bottle tops about 8 French 75s. Shopping lists in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: How Much Champagne for New Year's Eve? Bottles Per Guest

arguments.title: How to Open Champagne Safely (Like a Bartender)
arguments.description: Open champagne the bartender way: chill it well, put a towel over the cork, keep your thumb on top once the cage is loose, hold the cork and turn the bottle, and ease it out at an angle pointed away from people. A quiet sigh keeps the bubbles.
arguments.alt_text: How to Open Champagne Safely (Like a Bartender)

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Bar Setup: The 3-Zone Bar
arguments.description: Set up a New Year's Eve home bar in three zones: the batched French 75 with flutes, bubbles on ice with towels and an opener, and zero-proof drinks with water. Trash and a dump bucket go at the end. NYE menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Bar Setup: The 3-Zone Bar

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Prep: 5 Things to Do the Night Before
arguments.description: The night before New Year's Eve: chill the sparkling wine, batch gin and syrup for French 75s, print the menu, count flutes and clear freezer space. Squeeze lemons into the batch the next afternoon. NYE menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Prep: 5 Things to Do the Night Before
